sloka: एका जनयिता तात पुत्रम् वंशकरम् तव ।षष्टिम् पुत्र सहस्राणि अपरा जनयिष्यति ॥१-३८-८॥
transliteration: ekā janayitā tāta putram vaṁśakaram tava ।ṣaṣṭim putra sahasrāṇi aparā janayiṣyati ॥1-38-8॥

translations.english: O child, one wife will beget a son who will perpetuate your race and the other, sixty thousand sons, said Bhrugu.
